pr_title: graphql: add support for tx types and tx access lists
pr_body: fixes #22487  this PR adds the ability to query the type and AccessTuple from graphql endpoint

issue_context.title: GraphQL schema is not EIP-2718/EIP-2930 aware
issue_context.body:
#### System information

Latest master, last relevant commit https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/commit/39b3b8ffb44983a260031d5077226d952ddfb9bf

#### Expected behaviour

The GraphQL schema for `Transaction` should have `Type` and `AccessList` fields:

https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/master/graphql/schema.go#L73

#### Actual behaviour

The schema was not updated for EIP-2718/-2930.  With EIP-1559 on the horizon it might make sense long-term to refactor `Transaction` into a [union type](https://graphql.org/learn/schema/#union-types), something like `union Transaction = LegacyTransaction | AccessListTransaction | BaseFeeTransaction`.

#### Steps to reproduce the behaviour

As reported on go-ethereum discord the access list and type fields aren't queryable via GraphQL, obviously because they are not yet included in the schema.

review_comments: Ill add testcases to graphql_test.go for type and accessList properties retrieval.  When using types.AccessTuple I get `cannot define new methods on non-local type` so I created the local graphql type.
It's not possible to just return it because GraphQL requires wrapping API objects in a certain way.
